event_chain.summary: Website, phones and alarm services disrupted for days
Attackers' channel posts archive of allegedly stolen data

summary: On about January 26, 2026 Delta, a Russian provider of alarm and security systems for homes, businesses and vehicles, said it had been hit by a large-scale, coordinated cyberattack from an unspecified hostile foreign state. Its website and phone lines were offline for days while it restored from backups, and customers reported car alarms that could not be disarmed, remote-start failures and building alarms stuck in emergency mode. Delta said there was no evidence customer data was compromised, but a Telegram channel claiming to be run by the attackers posted an archive it said contained stolen data.
